releases.displayName: Happy New Year from all the team behind Imp of the Sun!

notes.title: It's a New Year and we're excited to share some more info with you on the game as we get closer to launch!

items.text: Over the next few months, we plan to bring you some posts on the characters, music, gameplay features etc. But first, we'll start with the background to the game and it's how the team at Sunwolf have looked to their past to inspire this new game.

notes.title: This year has flown by and we’ve achieved so much!

items.text: Development is nearly complete on the game and we are starting to put the finishing touches on the game and adding some exciting extra features like minibosses, challenge zones and secret passages for you to discover... As well as lots of post-game content to try out once you've ended the Eternal Eclipse!
You can even notice some of the slight changes made to our hero since the alpha! For the better, don't you think?
We're really excited for you to see more of Nin this year as we get closer to launch later this year. And who knows, you might even get the chance to play a snippet of the game early... ;-)

The game will be released later this year, although we have so much left to do here at Sunwolf before we can get the game in front of you, we can't wait for you all to get hands-on and let us know what you think!
We hear breaking the wishbone over your turkey dinner is good luck, however, we’ve found it’s much easier to knock a Skeleton head off while exploring the Underworld!

notes.title: Reason 1 - We got to record the soundtrack using historical instruments from Peru!

items.text: This year, we were lucky enough to visit a museum in Peru that showcases many Latin Americas musical treasures and historical artefacts!

Many of the instruments found in the museum can be heard in the Imp of the Sun soundtrack! Our personal favourite was the Cupisnique Whistle, which also happens to be the oldest instrument we recorded with and is estimated to be 6000 years old!
You can watch the music video here if you would like to find out more about the Soundtrack in Imp of the Sun!

notes.title: Reason 2 - We received a ton of great fan art from you!

items.text: We are so thankful for all our creative fans on Discord who have already started to submit fan art, we wanted to highlight some of them today! And the top 3 fan artists this year are… Vanished_._, H3ru and our top contributor Rex / American Donut!!!

notes.title: Reason 3 - We’ve already been featured in 2 online events and have so many to look forward to next year!

items.text: Back in August, we featured in Future Games Show at Gamescom, where we showcased a brand-new trailer! Since then we’ve had some coverage from global media outlets – some of which we’ve included below with our favourite quotes.
GamesRadar+ - “Help Bring the Light Back To A Beautiful 2D World In 2022”
GOG - “In 2022, Imp of the Sun Will Light a Fire in Your Heart”
Multiplayer.it - “Imp of the Sun Is An Exciting New 2D Action Platform Inspired By The Traditions And Folklore Of Peru”
We were also featured among 500+ other incredible Indie Games during the Indie Live Expo Winter Awards 2021!
So, thank you for being an amazing community so far and we’re so excited to bring you tons of content over the next few months!
